dct_description_sm: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.4 billion km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 91 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 2 years ( Last edited 7 months ago ) and 11% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : [indicators](https://github.com/hotosm/raw-data-api/tree/develop/docs/src/stats/indicators.md) , [metrics](https://github.com/hotosm/raw-data-api/tree/develop/docs/src/stats/metrics.md) This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [highway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway) - [surface](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:surface) - [smoothness](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:smoothness) - [width](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:width) - [lanes](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:lanes) - [oneway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:oneway) - [bridge](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:bridge) - [layer](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:layer) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [name:it](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:it) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
